_comment: DEVELOPMENT config. Same file shape as freshiq.json, but nothing physical is required: the motor is simulated and the camera falls back to sample_data/ when none is found. Use it to work on the dashboard, the scan flow or the API on a laptop.  Run with:  python backend/server.py --config config/freshiq.development.json

tray._stabilize_seconds: Short on purpose - there is no real platter to settle, and waiting 1.2 s per compartment makes UI work tedious.
tray._seconds_per_compartment: How long ONE compartment of travel should take. The MCU is told a per-step delay derived from this and steps_per_compartment, so changing the speed is a config edit and a restart - no re-flash. Raise it for a gentler tray, lower it for a faster scan. Must stay below motor.ack_timeout_seconds.

lighting._mode: No enclosure on a desk. Reports honestly so the dashboard shows the colour-consistency warning rather than implying controlled lighting.

server._host: Loopback only in development - do not expose a dev box to the LAN.
